A1.justification: Both readable, 35-page PDFs describe the same RocketKV work. Text, equations, figures, and tables support reliable comparison; Appendices A–B match exactly in extracted text and rendered pages.

before.justification: v2 reports original benchmark evaluations, ablations, and GPU efficiency measurements in Section 4 and Appendix B.

after.justification: v3 retains these original benchmark evaluations, ablations, and GPU efficiency measurements, including the detailed appendix results.

M1.justification: Sections 3.3–3.6 and Algorithm 1 retain the same SnapKV first stage, hybrid sparse attention, RocketKV-MT procedure, and adaptive compression decomposition.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the same LongBench, Needle-in-a-Haystack, RULER, and multi-turn SCBench coverage. No datasets, tasks, or test scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain Full-KV, Exact-TopK, DuoAttention, SnapKV, Quest, and SparQ. Appendix B.1 also retains the same standalone HSA comparisons.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendix A retain the model configurations, token budgets, truncation procedures, sample counts, and evaluation settings. Efficiency measurements still use FP16, batch size 1, and A100/H100 GPUs.

E4.justification: Appendix B retains the HSA-versus-Quest/SparQ analysis, adaptive-versus-static split-factor ablation, and Needle-in-a-Haystack heatmaps with identical evidence.

E5.justification: Both retain the same point estimates and benchmark averages. Neither adds repeated-run or seed information, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Reported values and plotted findings are unchanged. For example, Table 2 retains RocketKV's LongBench score of 51.1 and NIAH accuracy of 100.0 at token budget 256 on Llama3.1-8B-Ins. The efficiency plots and all appendix result tables also match.

T1.justification: Section 3.6 retains the compression-ratio definition, adaptive split formula, and storage/traffic derivations. Table 1 moves but preserves its mathematical expressions.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims, including up to 400× compression, 3.7× speedup, 32.6% peak memory reduction, and RocketKV-MT's near-oracle accuracy.

C2.justification: Interpretations and qualifications remain unchanged, including sensitivity to longer contexts, the multi-turn consequences of permanent eviction, RocketKV-MT's storage tradeoff, and explanations of GPU speedups.

D1.justification: v3 adds a source-code availability statement and the NVlabs/RocketKV GitHub address to the abstract; v2 contains no corresponding code-access pointer. Other implementation and reproducibility details are unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and positioning relative to permanent eviction, dynamic selection, and other attention-efficiency approaches are unchanged. Bibliography differences are layout shifts.

P1.justification: The abstract gains one code-availability sentence, and the arXiv version/date text changes. Otherwise, prose and section order are retained, with differences arising from text reflow.

P2.justification: Figure 1 moves from page 1 to page 2, and Table 1 moves from the left to the right column on page 6, with accompanying text reflow. Display contents remain unchanged, and appendix layouts are identical.

improvement.justification: The added code-access pointer modestly improves reproducibility documentation and discoverability over v2. Scientific content and supporting evidence remain unchanged, with only limited layout adjustments. The benefit concerns the access information supplied in the PDF; repository contents are not established by the local evidence.
